title: Maya the Bee flies out into the world.
lines: In a big bee colony a little bee is born.
And she has two funny little antennae.
In the hive you have to work, says the teacher, Miss Cassandra.
You stay close to the hive.
But Maya wants to see the world.
He likes sleeping and he likes eating.
I'll come with you, he says, yawning.
He wears a little hat and plays the violin.
Flip knows everything about the meadow.
Flip shows the friends around the meadow.
They meet a spider who weaves a beautiful web.
And a caterpillar who eats lots and lots.
Maya asks the caterpillar: Why do you eat so much?
One day I'll be a butterfly.
A few weeks later they see a beautiful butterfly.
But then Maya hears something scary.
They want to attack the hive.
They want to steal all the honey.
Maya has to warn her colony.
She flies as fast as she can.
But Maya shouts: Hornets are coming!
The queen bee listens to Maya.
They build a wall of wax in front of the door.
In the night the hornets come.
They all buzz really loudly together.
The hornets get a fright and fly away.
Now Maya may keep exploring the world.
As long as she comes back to tell stories.
And every evening Maya tells them about the meadow, about Flip, about the butterfly.
All the little bees listen with their mouths open.
